scope: Comparison of one existing committed-build replay and one independent-array decoder experiment; not allocation attribution or acceptance
method: For each run, match the driver's recorded stage timestamp to the nearest guarded process sample. Values are process private bytes rounded to MiB; page heap is the driver's performance.memory usedJSHeapSize rounded to MiB. Both used the same original PLY-3, full artifact read, direct browser observation and local file-input reopen. The independent decoder omitted the numeric-array reuse callback; the production code was not changed.

independent.reopenVerified: Not reached: subsequent geometry digest timed out and the guard reported an over-limit peak.

interpretation: At the recorded import stage the independent run's sampled renderer was approximately 595 MiB higher and its page heap approximately 382 MiB higher; browser and GPU samples were within 11 MiB. This points investigation toward renderer-side state, but the sampling times, allocator behavior and garbage collection can vary. It does not show which objects are retained, prove a specific allocation caused the failure, or justify weakening the resource limit.
